Minor point of procedure with that commit:

git diff --stat 9765346^
src/demo/agrad-demo.cpp | 24 ----
src/demo/big_parser.cpp | 224
------------------------------
src/demo/bivar_norm.cpp | 95 -------------
src/demo/bugs_rats.cpp | 267
------------------------------------
src/demo/cmd_line_options.cpp | 10 --
src/demo/cvine_covar.cpp | 222
------------------------------
src/demo/dummy.cpp | 144 -------------------
src/demo/file_io.cpp | 14 --
src/demo/norm_sample.cpp | 121 ----------------
src/demo/qi_symtab.cpp | 103 --------------
src/demo/test.cpp | 5 -
src/demo/tmp.cpp | 106 --------------
src/stan/gm/command.hpp | 62 ---------
src/stan/mcmc/adaptive_sampler.hpp | 46 ++++---
src/stan/mcmc/hmc.hpp | 3 +-
src/stan/mcmc/nuts.hpp | 114 ++++++++++++----
src/stan/mcmc/sampler.hpp | 82 ++---------
17 files changed, 135 insertions(+), 1507 deletions(-)

So, a bunch of stuff under src/stan (which I think was intended to go
into the previous commit) got lumped into the commit that removed a
bunch of demos. This would be a problem if at some point in the future
someone decided they wanted to revive (or just look at) one of those
demos. That would be pretty easy to do with a

git revert 9765346

but doing so would also revert all the changes to the sampler Bob did
under src/stan .

In general, a lot of the git tools are really powerful but work at the
commit level. So, to make full use of the git tools, the commits have
to be more precise than we have been doing in the svn era.

Ben

messages.subject: Re: src/demo status; gm to move, other stuff?
parts:
Right, contrary to svn where commit means "commit to the remote
repository", commit for git means "commit to the active local branch
only". And push pushes committed changes to the remote repository. If
you are in the root of stan, then something like this would do what
you want

git checkout master
git branch hmc_refactoring
git checkout hmc_refactoring

git rm src/demo/agrad-demo.cpp
...
git rm src/demo/tmp.cpp
git add src/demo/
git commit -m "remove some pure C++ demos"

git add src/stan/
git commit -m "finish refactoring the HMC code"

git checkout master
git merge hmc_refactoring
git push origin master

Ben
